This thing here:

[http://cgi.ebay.com/Heathkit-Photo-Time ... dZViewItem](http://cgi.ebay.com/Heathkit-Photo-Timer-Control-PT-15_W0QQitemZ180153536227QQihZ008QQcategoryZ3284QQssPageNameZWDVWQQrdZ1QQcmdZViewItem)

Can be used as a nifty exposure timer. I have one wired to an electronic shutter. It can time 0.1 to 99 seconds, which seems to cover most of what I do with HeNe/Silver. For longer exposures, I divide by two and hit the button twice. It has a switched 120V outlet...
